# Addressfinder

A reliably smart, reliably accurate data quality platform for address, email, and phone verification

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/addressfinder/.

## Actions

- **AU Address Autocomplete** (read-only): Perform interactive search of Australian addresses from the AddressFinder database.
- **AU Address Verification** (read-only): Verify Australian addresses against PAF/GNAF databases.
- **AU Location Autocomplete** (read-only): Perform interactive autocomplete search for Australian streets, suburbs, and states.
- **Email Verification API** (read-only): Verify email addresses including syntax validation, domain existence, and email account verification.
- **Get AU Address Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve full metadata for an Australian address selected from the Address Autocomplete API.
- **Get AU Location Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive metadata for an Australian location (street, suburb, or state) selected from the Location Autocomplete API.
- **Get NZ Address Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve full metadata for a NZ address including coordinates, census data, and postal details.
- **International Address Autocomplete** (read-only): Search for international addresses using autocomplete functionality.
- **NZ Address Autocomplete** (read-only): Perform interactive search for New Zealand addresses.
- **NZ Address Verification** (read-only): Verify New Zealand addresses against the Addressfinder database.
- **NZ Location Autocomplete** (read-only): Perform interactive search for New Zealand streets, suburbs, cities, and regions.
- **NZ POI Autocomplete** (read-only): Perform interactive search for points of interest in New Zealand.
- **Phone Verification API** (read-only): Verify phone numbers through syntax, range checks, and network verification.
- **Get International Address Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve full metadata for an international address selected from the Address Autocomplete API.
- **Get NZ Location Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve full metadata for a New Zealand location selected from the Location Autocomplete API.
- **Get NZ POI Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive metadata for New Zealand points of interest including coordinates and address details.
- **NZ Address Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Reverse geocode NZ addresses from GPS coordinates.
